note.value:
Step 1: Nominate target.

Step 2: Determine range by rolling an artillery die.

: If target in range, target is automatically hit (re-roll misses until a hit is scored), that location must make 2 saving throws taking 1 damage for each it fails.

Misfire: If artillery die roll is a misfire, the rockets hit the firing ship. Opponent rolls 1 low attack (re-rolling misses until a hit is scored). The location hit makes a saving throw at -1. Rocket Battery is destroyed.
